title: My House
text:
This is my house. It has three rooms and a small kitchen. There is a big table in the kitchen. I eat breakfast at the table.

My bedroom is upstairs. There is a bed, a desk and a lamp. The window is next to the bed. I like my room because it is bright.

questions.text: How many rooms does the house have?

options: A sofa, a TV and a fridge
A bed, a desk and a lamp

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the bedroom?
Where does the writer probably eat breakfast?

vocabulary.definition: the room where food is cooked
a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs

paragraph_translations: Це мій будинок. У ньому три кімнати і невелика кухня. На кухні є великий стіл. Я снідаю за столом.
Моя спальня нагорі. Там є ліжко, письмовий стіл і лампа. Вікно поруч із ліжком. Мені подобається моя кімната, бо вона світла.
